title: Expansion Program Economics Board — Gate/Aggregation

evidence.yield_rate: 100% — zero defects introduced across 113 content edits
evidence.s899_best: 20 items/session, zero defects — model proven but not sustained
evidence.readiness_score: Stalled at 75 since S864, no improvement in 4+ waves
evidence.bottleneck: Content design capacity — label-change pipeline exhausted. Stem rewrites required.
evidence.strength: Perfect yield rate and governance guard enforcement at scale
evidence.weakness: Throughput too low to close cognitive/difficulty gaps within any reasonable timeframe

evidence.fd075_critical: P1-FD-075: Certified item in active learner pool with ZERO renderable content — blank Stem, CC, EC, Choices. CRITICAL learner-safety defect.
evidence.dl021_certified: 95 Certified Pack E Section C items with empty distractor EW slots. Documentation conflict: CURRENT_BASELINES says OPEN, DEFECT_LIBRARY says RESOLVED. Status uncertain — learner safety can't be confirmed.
evidence.dl035_certified: 39 Certified Domain F items (28 Pack C + 11 Pack D) with ~117 empty distractor EW slots. Rule 6 deployed (prevention) but content remediation not yet executed.
evidence.dl031_inflation: ~500 items (19.7% of pool) with inflated difficulty labels — labeled Moderate, testing Remember/Understand
evidence.dl010_misassignment: Open HIGH — misassigned choice explanations (P1-A-029 prototype). Full-pool semantic scan not completed.
evidence.dl009_citations: Open HIGH — incorrect ASC authority citations (P1-A-012, P1-BC-065 area). Learners learn wrong authorities.
evidence.pack_e_explanation_quality: Weakest pack: avg 192 chars EC, min 30 chars. Pack A avg 417 chars for comparison.
evidence.strength: Structural completeness at 99.96% (1 broken item out of 2,540). Zero DL-008 in current certified pool.
evidence.weakness: FD-075 blank item is a CRITICAL unaddressed risk. Cognitive distribution is catastrophically below target. Multiple HIGH-severity open defects degrade educational quality for learners in active certified pool.

evidence.governance_guard_expansion: 5 rules → 9 rules (all BLOCK). 51/51 tests PASS. Strong positive signal.
evidence.analyze_evaluate_growth_rate: ~5.9 items/session — need ~147 more sessions at this rate
evidence.label_change_pipeline: EXHAUSTED — all non-DL-031 items already corrected
evidence.strength: Governance guard is expanding and hardening. Defect library is comprehensive. Certification integrity is maintained.
evidence.weakness: Readiness plateau at 75 is the clearest signal of stalled maturity. Defect backlog growing. Future growth requires more expensive operations (stem rewrites, not label changes).

evidence.master_question_registry: CRITICALLY STALE — 36.6h old, 1,245 entries missing, no Certified column, references obsolete scored_cases*.js architecture
evidence.baselines_accuracy: Pack D certified count: 392 (actual) vs 389 (CURRENT_BASELINES.md) — +3 discrepancy. index_updated.html hash: table has stale hash (586396F9) vs verification log (E0B7BBAA) — internal inconsistency.
evidence.documentation_conflicts: DL-021 status: CURRENT_BASELINES.md §3 says 'OPEN — 95 Certified items affected.' DEFECT_LIBRARY.md says 'Resolved — 0 DL-021 remaining (S828).' Learner pool safety cannot be confirmed from documentation.
evidence.certification_provenance: 0 of 2,500 MCQ items in Packs A-D carry certification_session metadata. 98.4% of certified items have no machine-readable certification provenance.
evidence.editorial_queue_tracking: No mechanism to track entry-to-exit duration. 38 mentions, unknown stall duration.
evidence.strength: Governance guard and test suite are excellent. REVISION_HISTORY.md is comprehensive.
evidence.weakness: Registry is the single largest operational risk. Documentation conflicts undermine trust in reported metrics. Baselines are drifting from reality.

evidence.automation_estimate: ~55% — governance guard and test suite automated; content authoring, calibration, documentation sync all manual
tooling_regressions: DL-028: DL-013 remediation script creates empty distractor slots. Tooling fix documented, not implemented.
DL-029: Regex block-window scan produces ~75% false-positive rate on DL-008. Scan scripts need CC-position-aware parsing.
evidence.ci_cd: None — no automated pipeline. Registry regeneration requires manual invocation. Baselines updates are manual.
evidence.strength: Governance guard provides reliable automated pre-write enforcement. Test suite is automated.
evidence.weakness: 53% uncategorized scripts indicate operational sprawl. Tooling regressions (DL-028, DL-029) are open — automation can't be trusted to produce reliable data. No CI/CD pipeline.

evidence.archived_clone_slots: 203 slots available for replacement (103 Pack C + 100 Pack D)
evidence.case_pool: 100% certified — 75 cases, 400 items across 3 case packs. Expansion-ready.
evidence.s899_model_proven: 20 items/session, zero defects, Analyze/Evaluate quality. Expansion model validated.
evidence.content_gap: ~200 items needed to close Sections E+F. At 5.6 items/day: ~36 days. At S899 throughput (20/session): ~10 sessions.
evidence.strength: The S899 model works. Case bank is ready. 203 archived slots provide structural capacity for expansion.
evidence.weakness: Throughput is the binding constraint. All 4 low-certified sections are DL-012 clone zones — the content to fill them doesn't exist yet. Requires sustained authoring commitment.

critical_risks: FD-075: P1-FD-075 is a Certified item in the active learner delivery pool with zero renderable content (missing Stem, CorrectChoice, ExplanationCorrect, Choices). Every learner who draws this item gets a blank/broken question. Needs immediate structural repair or pool removal.

DL-021 Status Conflict: CURRENT_BASELINES.md says 95 Certified Pack E Section C items have no distractor explanations (OPEN). DEFECT_LIBRARY.md says 0 DL-021 remaining (RESOLVED). Learner pool safety cannot be confirmed until this conflict is resolved — independent boundary-aware scan of Pack E Section C required.
DL-035: 39 Certified Domain F items in active learner pool with ~117 empty distractor ExplanationWrong slots. Rule 6 prevents new instances but existing items are unremediated.

DL-031 Systematic Difficulty Inflation: ~500 Certified items labeled Moderate that test Bloom's Remember/Understand. Distorts difficulty distribution metrics, analytics reporting, and any future adaptive testing.

MASTER_QUESTION_REGISTRY.md: 36.6 hours stale, 1,245 entries missing, references obsolete architecture. Any tool consuming this registry produces incorrect results. No Certified column exists — certification data is untracked in the official registry.

Cognitive Distribution Gap: 5.8% Analyze+Evaluate vs 40% CAQS target. Pool is dominated by low-Bloom's items (91% Understand+Apply). Not a learner-safety issue but a fundamental blueprint non-compliance gap.
conditions_for_sustainability: 1. IMMEDIATE (24h): Repair or downgrade FD-075 from Certified pool. A blank Certified item is the single most severe learner-facing defect.

2. IMMEDIATE (24h): Resolve DL-021 documentation conflict via independent boundary-aware scan of Pack E Section C. Establish authoritative status: are 95 Certified items missing distractor explanations or not?
3. IMMEDIATE (24h): Remediate DL-035 — author ~117 distractor explanations for 39 Certified Domain F items (S816-S818 already scheduled).
4. SHORT-TERM (1 week): Regenerate MASTER_QUESTION_REGISTRY.md — bring within 24h staleness threshold. Update to case_pack_* architecture. Add Certified column.
5. SHORT-TERM (1 week): Fix CURRENT_BASELINES.md §1 index_updated.html hash and Pack D certified count (+3 discrepancy). Resolve all baseline drift.
6. SHORT-TERM (1 week): Begin DL-031 difficulty recalibration for ~500 definition-match items. Label-only fix (~17 hours).
7. SHORT-TERM (1 week): Fix DL-029 scan methodology — migrate all scan scripts to CC-position-aware object-boundary parsing.
8. MEDIUM-TERM (2-4 weeks): Close Sections E+F certification gap via S900 Phase 2 program (10 batches of 20 items each). Target: 100% certified across all 30 sections.
9. ONGOING: Sustain authoring throughput at S899-proven rate (20 items/session) for Analyze/Evaluate content. Close the 866-item cognitive gap.
10. ONGOING: Categorize 119 uncategorized scripts. Archive deprecated tools. Fix DL-028 tooling regression.

trajectory.s358_note: S358 was Operational Value Realization — scored the platform's existing value, not its expansion readiness
trajectory.delta_explanation: S358 measured what works NOW. S362 measures readiness to GROW. The 35-point gap reflects the distance between 'functional at current scale' and 'capable of sustained expansion at CAQS quality targets.' The platform delivers value (86/100) but its expansion economics are significantly constrained (51/100).
